title: Pocketwire Rewards Redemption Valuation Rulebook: Whole-Balance Gift Card Value
content:
For a whole-balance Pocketwire Rewards gift card redemption, the points redeemed are the points balance on the handling date rounded down to a whole multiple of the tier's redemption increment, and the gift card value is the points redeemed multiplied by the tier's gift card value per point, divided by 100 and rounded down to the cent.

## Calculation

1. Points redeemed: the points balance on the handling date, rounded down to a whole multiple of the tier's redemption increment. A balance at or below zero gives no points to redeem.
2. Gift card rate: the tier's gift card value per point, in US cents per point.
3. Value in cents: the points redeemed multiplied by the gift card rate.
4. Gift card value: the value in cents divided by 100 and rounded down to the cent, once, at the end.

The tier figures read are the redemption increment and the gift card value per point of the member's tier.

## Worked examples (hypothetical balances and tier figures)

| Points balance | Increment | Points redeemed | Gift card rate (cents per point) | Value in cents | Gift card value |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 12368 | 100 | 12300 | 1.15 | 14145 | 141.45 USD |
| 12368 | 500 | 12000 | 1.00 | 12000 | 120.00 USD |
| 2399 | 100 | 2300 | 1.25 | 2875 | 28.75 USD |

## Basis questions

- Are points left over after rounding to the increment redeemed? No; they stay on the balance. In the first row 68 points remain.
- When is the value rounded? Only once, after the value in cents is divided by 100, and always down to the cent.
